title: Raised lead-row panel
description: The next/imminent departure (row 1 — here the SALIENDO/departing row) is lifted into a distinct raised surface-2 panel with an amber accent left-border and slightly larger type, so the next bus can be found instantly without reading the whole list. Rendered tile shows the board WITH this emphasis applied.
baseline_ref: .arrival-row:first-child plain row (same border-bottom treatment as every other row, .arrival-row__headsign clamp(1.6rem,9.5cqh,4.6rem)/700, .arrival-row__departing mono/800/accent-text)

changes.intent: Raise the imminent-departure row into its own panel: surface-2 fill, amber accent left-border, rounded, no bottom divider, small negative margin to bleed to the card edges.
Bump the lead row's headsign size slightly above the standard clamp so it reads first.
Scale the SALIENDO label up to match the enlarged lead row.
